title: Top Chinese AI company on October 31, 2026? Moonshot
rules: If Moonshot is the Highest Ranked Chinese AI Company model on Arena AI Text Score (Remove Style Control) on Oct 31, 2026 at 10:00am ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
Qualifying Chinese AI companies are defined as a company whose global or primary operational headquarters is located in mainland China.

Tied rankings shall be resolved using the publisher's official tie-breaking methodology; if none exists, all tied entities share the highest rank among them.

If multiple candidates are tied for a given rank, then their Contracts will resolve to $1/(the number of candidates tied), rounded down.

blind.reasoning: A source from about a day ago says Moonshot's Kimi K3 is currently the top Chinese model on the LMArena text arena, so Moonshot looks like the frontrunner. But the market uses the leaderboard with style control removed, which can reorder models scoring close together, and I couldn't check that view. Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM and ERNIE are all near the top and could release or update models in the roughly 12 days left. My search allowance ran out early, so the evidence is limited.
blind.falsifier: On Oct 31, 2026 at 10:00am ET, with style control removed, the Arena text leaderboard shows a model from Alibaba (Qwen), DeepSeek, Zhipu (GLM), Baidu (ERNIE), Xiaomi or another mainland Chinese company ranked above Kimi K3.

final.reasoning: The market can see the style-control-removed leaderboard I couldn't check, and a 13% price suggests Kimi K3 is not leading that view. I updated sharply toward the market, and my remaining gap above the ask is too small to bet on.
